overall.basis: Front = facade labelled 'elewacja frontowa' (picture 11) = entrance facade = bottom of the plan. Width 17.60 printed ('1760' top, '732' + '1028' bottom), left wall of the day wing to right wall of the bedroom wing. Depth 12.30 printed ('200' + '1030' left, '990' + '240' right): the closed body reaches the front line only over the day wing (0-7.32) and the rear line only over the bedroom wing (4.85-17.60); the 4.85 x 2.00 rear-left corner inside the 12.30 is an open roofed terrace and the 10.28 x 2.40 front-right corner is open (entrance porch in part), both excluded from the closed outline. Height 7.00 = ridge +6,68 minus ground -0,32 (section 13), equal to the published 7,0 m. Published built-up area 198,6 m2 is a separate fact (closed polygon 182.11; it plus the roofed terrace 9.70 and roofed porch ~6.0 is ~197.8).

mainRoof.notes: L-shaped hip roof, pitch 30 deg printed in section 13; eaves +3,04, ridge +6,68. Main ridge runs left-right parallel to the front over the bedroom block (~7.7 m long, TRACED from front/rear elevations); over the front-left day wing plus porch a hipped cross wing with a short front-to-back ridge (~2.5 m, TRACED) joins it in a T, with a valley down to the porch corner (front elevation and site plan). Eaves overhang about 0.85 m (dashed roof outline, TRACED). The roof also covers the rear-left terrace and the entrance porch. Two chimneys near the ridge. Graphite flat tiles.
